title: Ionic porous materials: from synthetic strategies to applications in gas separation and catalysis
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,3061-3139
DOI: 10.1039/D3CS01163A, Review Article
Xiaofei Lu, Penghui Zhang, Hanqian Pan, Pengyuan Yin, Peixin Zhang, Lifeng Yang, Xian Suo, Xili Cui, Huabin Xing
This review summarizes recent advancements in the synthetic strategies of ionic porous materials, and highlights the synergistic interplay of task-specific interactions with pore structure in key applications, including gas separation and catalysis.
